Case: Sign-up page loads with email field and unticked consent checkbox
Description:
• Pre-condition: User navigates to sso.sleekflow.io/u/signup/identifier (via Sign up link on login page).
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC1]
  • Traceability: "Step 1 Create your account: Email address (required) + unticked consent box: By checking this box, I/We confirm that I/we have read and agree to SleekFlow's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy."
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the SleekFlow app URL.
  2. Wait for redirect to Auth0 login page.
  3. Click the "Sign up" link to switch to signup form.
  4. Observe the signup identifier page elements.
Expected:
• Email address input field (#email) is visible and empty.
  • Consent checkbox (#terms-of-service) is visible and unticked by default.
  • Consent label text contains "Terms of Service" and "Privacy Policy".
  • "Sign up" button is visible.
BDD: Given a user navigates to the signup page, When the page loads, Then the email field is empty and the consent checkbox is unticked

Case: Password step is reached when valid email and ticked consent are submitted
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page at sso.sleekflow.io/u/signup/identifier.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC1]
  • Traceability: "Email address (required) + unticked consent box" — both must be valid for step 2.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Enter a valid, unused email address.
  3. Tick the consent checkbox.
  4. Click the "Sign up" button.
  5. Observe the resulting page.
Expected:
• User is redirected to the signup password step (/u/signup/password).
  • Password field and name field are visible on the new page.
  • No error message is displayed.
BDD: Given a user has entered a valid email and accepted the terms, When the user clicks Sign up, Then the password step is displayed

Case: Error message is shown when email field is empty on submit

• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page. Email field is empty.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC2]

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Leave the email field empty.
  3. Tick the consent checkbox.
  4. Click the "Sign up" button.
  5. Observe the error message.
Expected:

  • User remains on the signup identifier page.
BDD: Given a user has not entered an email, When the user clicks Sign up, Then the error 'Please enter an email address' is displayed

  2. Enter a valid email address.
  3. Leave the consent checkbox unticked.
  4. Click the "Sign up" button.
  5. Observe the area below the consent checkbox.

• Visible error text "Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to continue." is displayed under the checkbox.

Case: Focus moves to consent checkbox and live region announces error when Terms not accepted
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page. Valid email entered. Consent checkbox unticked.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC4]
  • Traceability: "focus moves to the box, and the live region announces the same text."
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Enter a valid email address.
  3. Leave the consent checkbox unticked.
  4. Click the "Sign up" button.
  5. Inspect the focused element.
  6. Check for live region (aria-live) content update.
Expected:
• Focus moves to the consent checkbox element.
  • A live region (aria-live="assertive" or "polite") announces "Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to continue."
BDD: Given a user submits the form without accepting terms, When the error appears, Then focus moves to the checkbox and the live region announces the error text

Case: Disposable email domain is rejected with correct error message and no account is created
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page. P0-3 disposable email blocking is active.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC5]
  • Traceability: "P0-3: Given an email on the blocklist (e.g. yopmail.com, mailinator.com), when the account would be created, then sign-up is denied with 'Please use a work or personal email address. Temporary email addresses can't be used.' and nothing is created."
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Enter an email with a disposable domain (e.g., test@yopmail.com).
  3. Tick the consent checkbox.
  4. Click "Sign up".
  5. Complete the password step if reached.
  6. Observe the error message.
Expected:
• Error message "Please use a work or personal email address. Temporary email addresses can't be used." is displayed.
  • No account is created for the disposable email address.
BDD: Given a user enters a disposable email domain, When the signup is attempted, Then the error about temporary email addresses is shown and no account is created

Case: Legitimate email domain is accepted and not rejected as disposable
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page. P0-3 disposable email blocking is active.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC5]
  • Traceability: Implied positive case — well-known domains (gmail.com, company.com) must not be falsely blocked.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Enter an email with a well-known legitimate domain (e.g., test@gmail.com).
  3. Tick the consent checkbox.
  4. Click "Sign up".
  5. Observe the result.
Expected:
• No disposable-email error is shown.
  • User proceeds to the password step normally.
BDD: Given a user enters a legitimate email domain, When the signup form is submitted, Then no disposable-email error is shown and the user proceeds to the password step

Case: Existing account email advances to password step with no account-existence notice
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page. The email entered already belongs to an existing account.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC6]
  • Traceability: "Current behavior: An email that already has an account moves on to the password step with no notice (SU-03)."
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Enter an email that is already registered.
  3. Tick the consent checkbox.
  4. Click "Sign up".
  5. Observe the resulting page.
Expected:
• User advances to the password step (/u/signup/password).
  • No message indicating the email already has an account is displayed on the identifier page.
BDD: Given a user enters an email that already has an account, When they submit the signup identifier form, Then the user advances to the password step with no enumeration notice

Case: Sign-up is denied when both email is disposable AND consent is unchecked
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the signup identifier page. Email is a disposable domain and consent is unticked.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC2, AC4, AC5]
  • Traceability: Combined validation — disposable email + missing consent.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Enter a disposable email (e.g., test@mailinator.com).
  3. Leave the consent checkbox unticked.
  4. Click "Sign up".
  5. Observe the error message(s).
Expected:
• At least one error message is displayed (consent error and/or disposable email error).
  • User remains on the signup identifier page.
  • No account is created.
BDD: Given a user enters a disposable email and does not accept terms, When they submit the form, Then signup is blocked with appropriate error messages

  2. Locate the consent label text.

  5. Return and click the "Privacy Policy" link.

Case: Email format error is shown on blur before form submission when blur validation is active
Description:
• Pre-condition: P2-2 blur validation feature is active. User is on the signup identifier page.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-002 · AC8]
  • Traceability: "P2-2: Validate email format on blur, not only on submit — faster feedback for the user."
  • Note: P2-2 is a future enhancement. Test only when feature is deployed.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the signup identifier page.
  2. Click into the email field.
  3. Type a malformed email (e.g., "notanemail").
  4. Click or tab away from the email field (trigger blur).
  5. Observe the page for inline validation feedback.
Expected:
• An inline email format error is shown immediately on blur, without needing to click "Sign up".
  • The error message indicates the email is not valid.
BDD: Given P2-2 blur validation is active and a user types a malformed email, When the user tabs away from the email field, Then an inline format error is shown before form submission
